title: Fury Water Adventures Key West
specs: Valid government issued photo ID with birth date is required for all adults taking the tour.
Credit card used for purchase must be present at check in with matching ID.
Minors must be accompanied by their actual parent.
Restrictions & Regulations: Guests must be at least 18 years old OR have their actual parent present at check in to participate.
14-15 years of age may operate a Jet Ski when riding with someone 18 years or older that meets the boating license criteria.
4-13 years of age are more than welcome to be a passenger with someone 18 years or older that meets the boating license criteria.
Combined weight cannot exceed 460 lbs (225 kg).
No carry on alcohol nor personal speakers are permitted.
Waivers must be completed PRIOR to check in.

services.desc: November 5th, 7th & 9th: Key West POWER BOAT RACES!!! Hosted by Race World Offshore The best views, front and center, Fury's Turn Boat puts guests in the action. services.name: Glass Bottom Boat Reef Eco Tour
services.desc: Glass Bottom Boat Eco Tour Unique & Informative Eco Tour Air-Conditioned Viewing Areas State-of-the-art Fury Catamaran “Window to the Reef” Provides Up Close Views for Everyone Large Seated Sundeck Explore dramatic underwater vistas generally reserved for scuba divers. A wide variety of fish and other sea creatures await you as you gaze into the underwater world of Key West. Along the way, our experienced captain and crew will provide a unique and informative eco tour and point out some of the most interesting marine life that inhabits the waters that surround this incredible island. Fury’s Windows to the Reef and Air Conditioned Cabin. Drinks & Snacks for Purchase ($) · 2hrs

services.name: Dolphin Watch & Snorkel Combo
services.desc: Dolphin Watch & Snorkel Trip Combo Witness local dolphins in their natural habitat Snorkel Along the Shallow Backcountry Includes snorkel gear and professional instruction Complimentary beer, wine, sodas & water Dolphin SMART-certified company Come aboard Fury’s Key West Dolphin Watch and Snorkel Tour for a journey to observe the grace and beauty of our resident Key West dolphins. Take our fast catamaran on an adventure into the shimmering turquoise waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Fury is part of “Dolphin SMART,” a program that protects and promotes the responsible observance of dolphins. Our Watch Dolphins in their natural habitat & Snorkel the backcountry. Unlimited Beverages · 3hrs
